correctness.rationale: Fresh proof reconstruction from RESULT.md: represent a selection by X,Y subsets of n matching columns and h absent columns. Distinct selected open neighborhoods within either clique iff h<=1; total domination iff p=0 forces q=n, q=0 forces p=n, p=1 forces X subset Y, q=1 forces Y subset X. Cross-clique signatures are distinct by the >=2-in-own-clique witness (or by direct p=q=1 boundary). Consequently the five conditions are necessary and sufficient. Weighted represented columns yield B(z)^n+nB(z)^(n-1); for n>=4 disjoint invalid low-occupancy corrections subtract 2n^2 z^(n-1)+2nz^n. Direct independent adjacency-bitmask brute checks all 4^n subsets n=2..7 and agrees with small-order and general polynomials. For n>=5 one empty column and two or more selected in each layer gives exact smallest count n(2^(n-1)-2n); n4 requires four selections and gives 56. Finite tests corroborate, while the structural proof is uniform.
